text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I gave it my all
and ran brilliantly to the very end!
choice_data_list: Congratulations on your victory, T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks to your support, I managed to finish ahead of Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAT!? Was this really okay?
Crossing the finish line before the guest of honor...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, oh noooo!?
I was running puffed up with pride like a true Overlord, but when did she...!?

...Neither was clearly better. But a race is
a race. Beating your opponent is always what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The results were quite surprising, weren't they?
Still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even if it was by chance, finishing ahead of Opera O-san really gave me confidence.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll be totally fine!
Even in a Senior Year GⅠ, no matter how long the distance is!
The Spring Shield gave Meisho Doto the fruit called confidence.
